63F, ELECTIVE admission from PHYSICIAN REFERRAL.
OUTCOME: discharged alive to HOME HEALTH CARE
PRESENTING SYMPTOMS: Nausea with vomiting; Lack of coordination; Other malaise and fatigue
PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS: Encounter for antineoplastic chemotherapy
ACTIVE DIAGNOSES: Meningitis, unspecified; Cerebral edema; Other malignant lymphomas, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites; Sarcoidosis; Lung involvement in other diseases classified elsewhere; Other acquired deformities of ankle and foot; Constipation, unspecified
PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: Encounter for antineoplastic chemotherapy; Surgical or other procedure not carried out because of contraindication
PROCEDURES: Single source photon radiosurgery; Spinal tap
MEDICATIONS: Bisacodyl 10mg PR; 0.9% Sodium Chloride 1000mL IV; Sulfameth/Trimethoprim DS 1TAB PO; Sodium Chloride 0.9%  Flush 3mL IV; Prochlorperazine 10mg PO; Acyclovir 400mg PO/NG; 0.45% Sodium Chloride 1000mL IV; Dexamethasone 10mg IV; LeVETiracetam 500mg PO/NG; Ondansetron 8mg IV; Sterile Water 50mL IV; Potassium Chloride 80mEq IV; Olanzapine (Disintegrating Tablet) 2.5mg PO; Heparin Flush (10 units/ml) 5mL IV; Docusate Sodium 100mg PO; Heparin Flush (100 units/ml) 5mL IV; Omeprazole 20mg PO; Lorazepam 1mg IV; Milk of Magnesia 30mL PO/NG; Olanzapine 2.5mg PO; Senna 1TAB PO/NG; Readi-Cat 2 (Barium Sulfate 2% Suspension) 900mL PO/NG; Nystatin Oral Suspension 5mL PO; Lactulose 30mL PO/NG; 5% Dextrose 100mL IV
MICROBIOLOGY: none
SERVICES: OMED
WARDS: Hematology/Oncology
_patient.note:
[1] The patient is a 63-year-old female admitted electively from physician referral.
[2] The patient presented with nausea with vomiting, lack of coordination, and other malaise and fatigue.
[3] The primary diagnosis is encounter for antineoplastic chemotherapy.
[4] The active diagnoses are meningitis, unspecified; cerebral edema; other malignant lymphomas, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites; sarcoidosis; lung involvement in other diseases classified elsewhere; other acquired deformities of ankle and foot; and constipation, unspecified.
[5] The patient has a past medical history of encounter for antineoplastic chemotherapy.
[6] The patient underwent single source photon radiosurgery and spinal tap.
[7] The patient received Bisacodyl 10mg PR, 0.9% Sodium Chloride 1000mL IV, Sulfameth/Trimethoprim DS 1TAB PO, Sodium Chloride 0.9% Flush 3mL IV, Prochlorperazine 10mg PO, Acyclovir 400mg PO/NG, 0.45% Sodium Chloride 1000mL IV, Dexamethasone 10mg IV, LeVETiracetam 500mg PO/NG, Ondansetron 8mg IV, Sterile Water 50mL IV, Potassium Chloride 80mEq IV, Olanzapine (Disintegrating Tablet) 2.5mg PO, Heparin Flush (10 units/ml) 5mL IV, Docusate Sodium 100mg PO, Heparin Flush (100 units/ml) 5mL IV, Omeprazole 20mg PO, Lorazepam 1mg IV, Milk of Magnesia 30mL PO/NG, Olanzapine 2.5mg PO, Senna 1TAB PO/NG, Readi-Cat 2 (Barium Sulfate 2% Suspension) 900mL PO/NG, Nystatin Oral Suspension 5mL PO, Lactulose 30mL PO/NG, and 5% Dextrose 100mL IV.
[8] The patient was managed by the OMED service.
[9] The patient was admitted to the Hematology/Oncology ward.
[10] The patient was discharged alive to home health care.
